people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: Ahinoam
people.line: Wife of King Saul, daughter of Ahimaaz

people.name: Ner
people.line: Father of Abner, King Saul's commander.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.
translations.bsb: His wife’s name was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the commander of his army was Abner, the son of Saul’s uncle Ner.
translations.kjv: And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.
translations.asv: and the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. And the name of the captain of his host was Abner the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.
